title: Accused murderer of innocent woman in brothel dies in hospital
article: A violent criminal accused of murdering a middle-aged woman in a condo bordello died in hospital on Monday.
Ricardo Mirabelles, 37, was facing a first-degree murder charge in connection with the Jan. 13 death of Maryna Kudzianiuk, 49. He never left hospital after being shot by police.
Sources told the Toronto Sun that Mirabelles apparently ingested a toxic substance when he was arrested near the Scarborough Town Centre last month.
An autopsy will be performed on Mirabelles on Tuesday. Mirabelles, a highly- skilled welder, has a lengthy criminal record.
He was sentenced to four years imprisonment in Calgary in 2002 for discharging a firearm.
On Jan. 18, police surrounded his vehicle near the Scarborough Town Centre. When Mirabelles wouldn't surrender and appeared ready to resist, officers shot him multiple times.
Sources told the Sun the gunshot wounds didn't cause his death.
The Special Investigations Unit is still investigating the police shooting.
Sources told the Sun the killer forced Kudzianiuk into a nearby bedroom - where there was no surveillance camera - and inflicted fatal injuries.
The man started vigorously cleaning up the scene before he set it ablaze, the source said.
Despite the man's efforts, an enormous amount of invisible blood spatter remained at the scene.
When police sprayed a substance which detects trace quantities of blood, the scene " lit up like Times Square on New Year's Eve, " the source said.
